title: MasalBench: A Benchmark for Contextual and Cross-Cultural Understanding of Persian Proverbs in LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2601.22050v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In recent years, multilingual Large Language Models (LLMs) have become an inseparable part of daily life, making it crucial for them to master the rules of conversational language in order to communicate effectively with users. While previous work has evaluated LLMs' understanding of figurative language in high-resource languages, their performance in low-resource languages remains underexplored. In this paper, we introduce MasalBench, a comprehensive benchmark for assessing LLMs' contextual and cross-cultural understanding of Persian proverbs, which are a key component of conversation in this low-resource language. We evaluate eight state-of-the-art LLMs on MasalBench and find that they perform well in identifying Persian proverbs in context, achieving accuracies above 0.90. However, their performance drops considerably when tasked with identifying equivalent English proverbs, with the best model achieving 0.79 accuracy. Our finding

translated_title: MasalBench：用于评估大语言模型对波斯谚语上下文与跨文化理解能力的基准测试
translated_abstract: 近年来，多语言大语言模型（LLMs）已成为日常生活中不可或缺的一部分，因此它们必须掌握会话语言的规则，才能与用户进行有效沟通。尽管以往的研究已评估了LLM对高资源语言中比喻性语言的理解，但其在低资源语言中的表现仍未得到充分探索。本文提出了MasalBench，这是一个全面的基准测试，用于评估大语言模型对波斯谚语的上下文和跨文化理解能力，而波斯谚语正是这种低资源语言日常会话中的关键组成部分。我们在MasalBench上评估了八个最先进的大语言模型，发现它们在识别语境中的波斯谚语方面表现良好，准确率超过0.90。然而，当任务要求识别对应的英语谚语时，它们的表现显著下降，其中表现最好的模型准确率仅为0.79。
tldr: 该论文提出MasalBench基准测试，发现大语言模型虽然能很好地识别语境中的波斯谚语（准确率超过0.90），但在识别对应英语谚语时性能大幅下降（最佳模型仅为0.79），揭示了LLM在低资源语言跨文化理解方面的不足。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces MasalBench, a benchmark showing that while state-of-the-art LLMs excel at identifying Persian proverbs in context (accuracy above 0.90), their performance drops considerably when identifying equivalent English proverbs, with the best model achieving only 0.79.
